purpose: Define bounded peer discovery from publish/register through lookup, rendezvous match, signaling handoff and cleanup.

topics.name: Hello Peer Discovery Lifecycle
topics.purpose: Define bounded peer discovery from publish/register through lookup, rendezvous match, signaling handoff and cleanup.

semantics.publish_rule: Peer/service discoverability is explicit and policy-governed.
semantics.lookup_rule: Lookup resolves discovery metadata, not application authority.
semantics.match_rule: Matched state identifies candidate peer/session handoff only.
semantics.handoff_rule: Successful match hands off to WebRTC/other configured peer transport establishment.
semantics.cleanup_rule: Bootstrap metadata is removed/expired after establishment/cancel/timeout.
semantics.identity_rule: Lifecycle state/session identity does not redefine peer semantic identity.
semantics.failure_rule: Discovery failure does not silently substitute an unrelated peer.

invariants.rule: Hello/Rendezvous performs peer discovery/bootstrap only; it never becomes application-payload owner, semantic peer identity, or authorization authority.

hard_gates.condition: matched state treated as authorized application session
peer identity changes across discovery states

references.purpose: Discovery hands off to peer transport.
